text: The authors define (c, q)-expansion on sets (A, B): every subset U of B with P(U|B) > q has a neighborhood with P(N(U)|A) > c P(U|B). Their theorems only require this for structured collections M of subsets of B corresponding to elements of the student hypothesis class (Definition 4), which they say is the key to their results in Section 5 on checking the expansion property.
title: Definition: (c, q)-expansion for sets generated by the student hypothesis class
